summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing updates to its stock repurchase program, authorized to acquire up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A and Class B common stock. Terms: $1 billion authorization, no per-share price or premium stated; board authorized but no advisor named. The filing is triggered by ASX daily disclosure rules; mechanics involve open-market purchases. What to watch: pace of buyback execution and market conditions affecting repurchase timing; no risk-arb angle as this is an ongoing capital return plan.
